objective: Review the changed-source correction at this exact commit relative to eb6f568c6b70682b6555f17128beb1d028f10150 (runtime) and 41683cf02aa2039b14a99f179496a4ca9c91e477 (signal kernel). Review end-to-end permission, gas/accounting, finality and race boundaries; no funds/custody/inference/launch expansion.
